selected_evidence.study: ONS England, Health Survey for England 2013–2019, national probability household sample and weighting, overall analytic n=26,751; released 2024.

selected_evidence.qualification: Historical England findings, not current Spanish prevalence. The 46% denominator includes both type 2 diabetes and good/very good self-rated health; it is not 46% of all adults or all adults with diabetes. The two statistics do not establish that routine normal bloodwork hid disease or that EVA’s kit diagnoses diabetes.

statement_opening_selection.latest_evidence_requirement: National population sampling/coverage and appropriate weighting are required for countrywide claims.
